bio.text: Linda Coleman-Madison, a Democrat, has represented District 20 in the Alabama State Senate since 2006 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
According to Ballotpedia, she served on the Birmingham City Council from 1985 to 1997.
She received a B.S. in education from Alabama A&M University and a master's degree from the University of Alabama.
